method: New independent Python calculation from saved raw integer timestamps, JSON, F32/I32 bytes. No supplied verify/analyze code is imported or executed.

boundaries.performed: Local saved-byte comparisons, finite scans, metadata consistency checks, arithmetic from all saved timestamps.
boundaries.record_only: Model/native weight hashes, DSO hashes and providers, worker affinity, interposer counters, direct rounding kernel execution, process exits and machine restoration are saved runtime records; absent model/DSO contents were not reexecuted or certified.
boundaries.not_performed: No real-machine API, build, inference, benchmark, deployment, new hardware timing, or model/ELF execution.
boundaries.units: FBC 768 timed T1 in 6 processes; H1 1536 steady mode observations plus 128 separate first-use observations in 4 processes; CPU08 120 timed eight-graph samples / 960 graph calls in 8 processes. These counts do not create that many independent fresh processes.
boundaries.quality_sample_units: CPU08 also has one single-graph sample per quality process/cell: 6 recorded quality samples. These are excluded from the 120 timed samples / 960 graph calls and from performance summaries.
boundaries.output_sampling: FBC quality 65 rows/case/arm and timing final row. H1 saved final mode output, not every timed call output. CPU08 one saved output/cell/process and recorded sample endpoint FNV, not 960 individually saved outputs.
